official_sources.title: Performance API: Оптимизация контроля доступов через OAuth
official_sources.evidence: For Russian sellers, OAuth authorization is being introduced in Performance API; Ozon says a single access token can be used for Seller API and Performance API, and the seller selects required scopes in Seller Center. It does not document a legacy client_credentials-to-seller identity endpoint or response schema.

official_sources.title: FAQ: Сервисы для бизнеса и Личный кабинет разработчика
official_sources.evidence: The FAQ describes POST /oauth/me as a bodyless call with only Authorization: access_token, returning information about the currently authorized seller and the app subscription; the Seller OAuth guide's permission example names /v1/oauth/me. This is a Seller OAuth endpoint, not documented as accepting a legacy Performance client_credentials token. The linked Applications API reference is dynamically rendered and exposed no machine-readable response schema in this review.

official_sources.title: Процесс OAuth-авторизации для доступа к Ozon Seller API
official_sources.evidence: Authorization Code Flow obtains an OAuth token after seller consent. Ozon documents that access_token.sub is Seller ID for authorization_code, while sub is the application's Client ID for client_credentials. Since the task forbids JWT-derived identity, sub is not used as the proposed identity proof; it confirms that client_credentials sub is not a seller crosswalk. The page documents prompt=select_company.

official_sources.title: Изменение отдаваемых ошибок, связанных с API-ключами Seller API
official_sources.evidence: The documented Seller API 404 error says the API key was not found for the supplied seller_id. This can support the previously proposed authenticated Seller Client-Id/key pair binding only when the provider response is strictly matched to this documented condition and the successful response has strict seller-info schema. It says nothing about linking a Performance client_credentials pair.

official_sources.title: Performance API: новый домен
official_sources.evidence: Confirms api-performance.ozon.ru is the current Performance host and the previous performance.ozon.ru host was retired.

legacy_performance_client_credentials.documented_minimal_authentication: POST https://api-performance.ozon.ru/api/client/token with the legacy client_id/client_secret grant can establish credential/token acceptance if it returns a strict successful token response.
legacy_performance_client_credentials.allowed_identity_conclusion: Credentials accepted for the Performance API only; seller identity and same-cabinet relationship remain unverified.
prohibited_inferences: client_id or app name as seller identity
matching seller/client names, INN, or user-supplied labels
campaign/analytics/report contents as a seller crosswalk

unified_oauth.documented_for_performance: Yes, for Russian sellers per the 2026-04-06 Ozon announcement.
unified_oauth.documented_seller_proof: Seller-consented Authorization Code Flow plus authenticated POST /oauth/me is the documented route to current authorized seller information. Use a strict provider response field for seller_id only after obtaining and validating the authoritative response schema; do not decode JWT locally as the identity proof.
unified_oauth.same_token_cross_api: Ozon explicitly says one access token may be used for both Seller and Performance APIs, with scopes selected by the seller. A successful harmless read-only Performance API call using that same seller-authorized token, alongside /oauth/me proof, can establish that the Performance grant is attached to that Seller OAuth authorization.
unified_oauth.qualification: The announcement is scoped to sellers in Russia. Ozon's linked API docs are dynamically rendered; the precise /oauth/me JSON schema and a minimal no-report Performance read endpoint need direct official schema confirmation before implementing strict extraction.

recommended_model.near_term: Keep legacy Performance credentials in IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED (or introduce a clearly distinct AUTHENTICATED_UNLINKED status if product wants to report valid credentials). Do not set store.verified_identity or mark same-cabinet CONNECTED from token success alone.
correct_same_cabinet_route: Add a seller-consented Ozon OAuth Authorization Code flow for eligible accounts, with CSRF state and explicit company selection where needed.
Call POST /oauth/me using the returned access token and strictly parse the officially confirmed seller_id field from the authenticated JSON response.

Use that same access token against one minimal read-only Performance endpoint whose OAuth support/scope is documented; do not call reports, statistics, financial methods, or mutating campaign methods.
Promote a shared Ozon seller identity only when both authenticated checks bind to the same seller authorization; otherwise retain channel-specific unlinked states.
recommended_model.independent_channel_option: If product semantics allow a user-created grouping rather than a verified same cabinet, model Seller and Performance as distinct channel connections and label their association as user-selected/unverified. No stable Performance account identity endpoint was found in the official materials reviewed, so do not invent a canonical Performance seller ID.

blockers_for_implementation: The existing legacy Performance client_credentials pair has no official identity/crosswalk contract identified in the reviewed Ozon material.
Current store schema has a single verified_identity and therefore cannot truthfully mark a legacy Performance key as the same Seller cabinet when the only result is token acceptance.
The exact /oauth/me JSON response schema and a minimal read-only Performance endpoint using the unified token must be confirmed from official API schema before strict implementation.
not_performed: provider API calls or credential reads
server, database, session, or environment access
